hook.en: Not every challenge was met with weapons. Some Malay rulers fought with constitutions, diplomacy and modern government — and kept their states free of a Resident.
hook.bm: Bukan semua cabaran dihadapi dengan senjata. Sesetengah raja Melayu berjuang dengan perlembagaan, diplomasi dan pemerintahan moden — dan berjaya mengelakkan Residen.

bigIdeas.en: Rulers of Kedah, Kelantan, Terengganu and Johor protested and delayed British control.
bigIdeas.bm: Pemerintah Kedah, Kelantan, Terengganu dan Johor membantah dan melambatkan kawalan British.

bigIdeas.en: Rulers used diplomacy, written constitutions and modern administration to protect sovereignty.
bigIdeas.bm: Raja-raja menggunakan diplomasi, perlembagaan bertulis dan pentadbiran moden untuk mempertahankan kedaulatan.

bigIdeas.en: Malay chiefs such as Dato' Jaafar Muhammad (Johor) and Wan Mohd Saman (Kedah) led modernisation.
bigIdeas.bm: Pembesar Melayu seperti Dato' Jaafar Muhammad (Johor) dan Wan Mohd Saman (Kedah) memimpin pemodenan.

definition.en: Managing relations through negotiation instead of war.
definition.bm: Mengurus hubungan melalui rundingan dan bukan peperangan.

definition.bm: Hak sesebuah negeri memerintah dirinya sendiri.

question.en: How did the Johor Constitution of 1895 protect Johor from British control?
question.bm: Bagaimanakah Undang-undang Tubuh Kerajaan Johor 1895 melindungi Johor daripada kawalan British?

steps.en: It set out a modern, organised system of government.
steps.bm: Ia menetapkan sistem pemerintahan yang moden dan tersusun.

steps.en: It stated that Johor must not be handed over to any foreign power.
steps.bm: Ia menyatakan bahawa Johor tidak boleh diserahkan kepada mana-mana kuasa asing.

answer.en: It showed Johor was well governed and legally guarded its sovereignty, giving Britain less reason to intervene.
answer.bm: Ia menunjukkan Johor ditadbir dengan baik dan mempertahankan kedaulatannya dari segi undang-undang, jadi British kurang alasan untuk campur tangan.
